label: batch-5
tail:
Completed the full 38-item batch-5 audit and dependency read.

Four fatal finding families were repaired, subject to Alpha adjudication:

- False finite-cover bound permitting negative coefficients.
- Circular Cavalieri use before image Jordan measurability.
- Unlicensed local-distortion extension to arbitrary Jordan subsets.
- Missing \(n\ge1\) hypotheses across 14 determinant/Euclidean interfaces.

All 15 batch-9 dependency occurrences were verified. The real determinant equivalence is used correctly; the weaker ring-level unit corollary is not substituted. Stale source numbering was corrected against the current [Lebl treatment](https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/sec_mvchangeofvars.html) and [Leibman PDF](https://people.math.osu.edu/leibman.1/analysis2/m-analysis.pdf).

Validation is green: 35/35 prechecks, 35/35 strict proof contracts, content policy, coverage, rendering, prose, and dependency checks.

Full per-item evidence: [frontier-10-reader-5.findings.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-10-reader-5.findings.md).
